verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair axis for a video and voice platform that stores recordings and transcripts, so the story applies. The pack has no documented retention settings, deletion APIs or data-purge controls. Storing recordings in the customer's own bucket, end-to-end encryption, HIPAA BAAs and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework are related privacy features, but none of them is retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
